system.description: Starting at 14th level, you know when to get out of dodge and make yourself scarce. When you take damage or fail a saving throw, you may spend your reaction. When you do, first you summon a Bunshin to occupy the space you are currently in, and then teleport into the space of another Bunshin within 60 feet of you. The Bunshin you teleport to is dispelled as part of this teleportation. If this teleport would place you into a space that is at least lightly obscured, you can attempt a Hide skill action.
